hypothesis: Train-only per-dimension scaling of the future-minus-current H3 error will prevent high-variance frozen-H3 directions from hiding the action-dependent consequence signal and make the conditioned temporal expert beat zero-action and shuffled controls in both seeds.
single_variable: C36 changes only the consequence error metric from raw projected-H3 MSE to MSE divided by the train-only per-dimension standard deviation of future-minus-current H3; C35 data, features, models, seeds, optimizer, steps and gates remain fixed.
parent_baseline: C35 SHA256 0967fb0301611d99c745ae3e959647479f150b37399744b9e8351685e80cfa8c: temporal beat flattened in both seeds and shuffle hurt 5.1%-6.1%, but seed314159 missed the independent gate by 0.38%, so repeated mechanism status remained FAIL and value ranking stayed blocked.

references.title: FACT: A Failure-Aware Causal Transformer for World Action Models

architecture.upstream_code: FACT uses clean action K/V and MiniWorld temporally aligned action modulation.
architecture.local: The C35 flattened and eight-token temporal experts are reused byte-for-byte; H3 and the action parent remain frozen.
architecture.rationale: Architecture is deliberately not a C36 variable.

data.paper: Future targets and held-out outcomes come from separate trajectories.
data.upstream_code: FACT retains failures and computes normalization from training data.
data.local: The identical C34 dataset supplies 37 train, 8 consequence-validation and 52 reserved ranking sources; only the 296 train branches compute target scale.
data.rationale: No validation or C33 ranking feature contributes to normalization.

action.paper: Clean actions condition the associated future.
action.upstream_code: FACT and MiniWorld preserve action/future temporal alignment.
action.local: The same audited 32x7 executed prefixes and 221 zero-masked partial tails are consumed.

objective.paper: Future-state and visual objectives operate in normalized model spaces.
objective.local: Prediction and target errors are divided by the train-only per-dimension std of projected future H3 minus projected current H3; the same conditioned/shuffled/zero controls and 1% gates remain.
objective.rationale: Frozen H3 is not robot state, so its action-relevant change is scaled directly instead of borrowing proprio statistics.

optimization.upstream_code: Target normalization does not alter optimizer topology.
optimization.local: Flattened/temporal x seeds42/314159, three arms each, 10,000 steps, batch64, AdamW3e-4/1e-2 and checkpoints every1,000 are unchanged.

evaluation.paper: Held-out future/value metrics gate downstream selection.
evaluation.upstream_code: FACT uses unseen episodes before best-of-N.
evaluation.local: Eight unseen consequence sources are evaluated in the predeclared scaled metric; both seeds must pass, while all 52 C33 sources remain untouched for later ranking.
evaluation.rationale: C36 still makes no ranking or closed-loop claim.

evidence: No model class or dimension differs from C35; temporal/flattened tests pass.
C34 identity fixed; target scale consumes train branches only; train/validation/ranking source overlap0.
All proposed actions match artifacts and unexecuted tails remain zero; 11 focused tests PASS.
train_delta_std is an explicit fixed launcher argument; raw MSE remains diagnostic but cannot replace the preregistered scaled gate.
C35-matched four jobs, 10,000 steps, batch64, seeds42/314159 and identical AdamW settings.
Eight consequence-validation sources only; C33 52-source ranking reserve remains unconsumed.
Scaling is a fixed train-stat tensor; actions remain detached and action-expert gradients remain finite/nonzero in tests.
11 focused tests PASS; live train delta std spans 7.7573 to 24.9895 with no zero or non-finite dimensions.
Scaled two-step checkpoint stores the target scale and restores exactly under the existing strict production gate.
C35 repeated result and all four checkpoint/report hashes frozen before C36 implementation.
No value ranker or closed-loop selector is authorized yet.

decision.rationale: C35 showed reproducible action sensitivity but a marginal independent-baseline miss in one temporal seed. FACT's train-stat normalization and the measured 3.2x spread in H3 change scale justify this single-variable matched ablation before changing architecture.
decision.launch_command: On ports 32611/30907/32409/30234 set C36_RUN_INDEX=0/1/2/3 and run bash scripts/h3wam/launch_c36_delta_scaled_consequence_sweep.sh; aggregate all four reports with the unchanged sweep evaluator.
